world.title: Trump expects Iran war to end after US midterm elections, says ‘oil prices will come tumbling down’
world.summary: Donald Trump stated he expects the conflict between Iran and the United States to conclude shortly after the upcoming midterm elections. He suggested that Iran is delaying resolution to influence the elections. Trump expressed confidence that once the war ends, oil prices will significantly decrease. His comments were made during a press conference in Dublin.

world.title: BRICS declaration condemns Pahalgam terror attack, sends veiled message to Pakistan
world.summary: The BRICS declaration condemns the April 2025 terror attack in Jammu and Kashmir, urging action against terrorist entities and their safe havens. This statement coincides with a meeting between Indian Prime Minister Modi and Chinese President Xi in New Delhi, reflecting a broader improvement in India-China relations. The declaration serves as a veiled message directed at Pakistan.

world.title: Indian landlady in Canada held after tenant’s ‘harassment’ over barbecue use
world.summary: An Indian-origin woman, Raj Tiwana, was arrested in Canada after her tenant accused her of harassment regarding barbecue use at their rental property. The tenant shared videos of the confrontations on Instagram, which gained significant attention on social media. The incident highlights ongoing tensions between landlords and tenants, particularly concerning shared amenities in rental agreements.

business.title: RBI rejects Tata Sons' application to surrender NBFC licence, reports CNBC-TV18
business.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has rejected Tata Sons' application to surrender its non-banking financial company (NBFC) license. As a result, Tata Sons must adhere to RBI regulations for upper-layer NBFCs, which include the obligation to list on stock exchanges. This decision impacts Tata Sons' operational framework within the financial sector, according to a CNBC-TV18 report.

business.title: ET Exclusive: RBI blocks Tata Sons' bid to stay private, forcing listing of Rs 2.01 lakh crore giant
business.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has denied Tata Sons' request to surrender its registration, paving the way for a potential public listing of the holding company. Tata Sons is now required to adhere to regulations for upper-layer non-banking financial companies. This ruling ensures that Tata Sons will remain under stricter regulatory oversight for a minimum of five years.

business.title: HDFC Bank sends two names to RBI for next MD & CEO
business.summary: HDFC Bank's Board has recommended two candidates to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for the position of Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer. This move includes the creation of a fourth Whole-time Director position to improve oversight. The candidates' names and proposed remuneration have been submitted in order of preference for RBI's approval.

technology.title: Triptii Dimri’s Animal 'Love Bite' Inspires Apple’s Burgundy iPhone 18? Viral Post Makes Bizarre Claim
technology.summary: An Instagram post by 'satirelogy' claimed that Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro burgundy color was inspired by actress Triptii Dimri's romantic mark in the film Animal. The post, clearly labeled as satire, included a fictional statement from Apple CEO John Ternus and garnered 3.3K likes. The claim is entirely fabricated and not based on any official information.

technology.title: Complete list of EA FC 27 trophies & achievements
technology.summary: EA FC 27 features a total of 47 trophies and achievements for PlayStation and Xbox players. The Platinum trophy, "The Collector," is awarded for unlocking all other trophies, excluding additional content. Other notable achievements include completing Alex Hunter’s and Kylian Mbappé’s milestone objectives in "The Grounds." Players can refer to the complete list for detailed unlocking requirements.

sports.title: Shreyas Iyer admits to having to make ‘tough call’ between Samson, Abhishek and Sooryavanshi: ‘Player sitting out…’
sports.summary: India's T20I captain Shreyas Iyer discussed the challenging decision of selecting two opening batters for the first match against Afghanistan. He has three options: Sanju Samson, Abhishek Sharma, and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. Iyer did not reveal his final choice, acknowledging the difficulty of the situation and the impact on the player who will ultimately sit out of the game.

sports.title: 2026 F1 Spanish Grand Prix - Madrid Free Practice 3 results
sports.summary: Kimi Antonelli topped the timesheets in a disrupted Free Practice 3 session for the 2026 F1 Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid. The session experienced two red flags, with the first caused by Lewis Hamilton, leading to significant delays for barrier repairs. Teams prepared for the upcoming race amid challenging conditions, impacting their practice strategies and performance evaluations.

sports.title: India vs Afghanistan 1st T20I: Delhi Traffic Police issue advisory amid BRICS Summit
sports.summary: The Delhi Traffic Police issued a traffic advisory ahead of the India-Afghanistan T20I match at Arun Jaitley Stadium on September 13. The advisory includes traffic restrictions, diversions, and parking rules to manage congestion during the event. This measure coincides with the ongoing BRICS Summit, aiming to ensure smooth traffic flow in the area during the cricket match.

health.title: Dose RSV Vaccine Vial to Protect Infants
health.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has prequalified a multi-dose vial of the maternal respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine, RSVpreF (ABRYSVO). This development aims to enhance access to the vaccine, which is designed to protect infants from severe RSV infections. The introduction of a lower-cost option is expected to improve vaccination coverage and reduce the impact of RSV globally.

health.title: India administers 80 lakh HPV vaccine doses since February
health.summary: India has administered over 80 lakh doses of the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine since February, marking a significant milestone in its cervical cancer prevention efforts. The National HPV Vaccination Campaign aims to reduce the incidence of cervical cancer through widespread vaccination. This initiative reflects the country's commitment to improving public health and combating preventable diseases among its population.

health.title: Beyond Digestion: The Hidden Power Of The Gut In Ageing, Immunity And Cancer Care
health.summary: Research indicates that the gut microbiome significantly influences immunity, metabolism, and overall health, extending beyond digestion. Experts suggest that targeting the gut could enhance cancer treatment, particularly in conjunction with immunotherapy. As scientific understanding of the gut's complexities advances, its connections to ageing, inflammation, and personalized cancer care are becoming increasingly relevant in medical discussions.

science.title: cIGW-SC: an intelligent chaotic hybrid grey wolf and sine cosine optimizer for complex engineering design problems
science.summary: The cIGW-SC is a new optimization algorithm combining an Improved Grey Wolf Optimizer with the Sine Cosine Algorithm to address challenges in complex engineering design. Evaluated on 72 benchmark functions, it achieved a 94% success rate, outperforming existing methods. Its effectiveness was confirmed through statistical tests, demonstrating strong performance across various engineering applications, including gear trains and hydrothermal scheduling.

science.title: Integrated transcriptomics and metabolomics reveal key metabolic pathway responses in Myzus persicae (Sulzer) to facilitate arbovirus transmission under cold stress
science.summary: Cold stress significantly affects Myzus persicae's ability to acquire and transmit Potato virus Y (PVY). A multiomics study showed that at 5°C, aphids increased feeding frequency and probing activity, with acclimated individuals responding faster. Metabolomic and transcriptomic analyses revealed changes in ABC transporters and lipid metabolism, indicating that cold stress enhances vector competence through behavioral and molecular adaptations.

entertainment.title: This 4-year-old broke Kamal Haasan’s record and became India’s youngest National Award winner: Meet Treesha Thosar
entertainment.summary: Treesha Thosar, a four-year-old actress, has become India's youngest National Award winner by receiving the Best Child Artist award for her performance in "Naal 2." This achievement surpasses the previous record held by veteran actor Kamal Haasan. Treesha's recognition highlights her exceptional talent at a young age, marking a significant milestone in Indian cinema.

entertainment.title: Sardaar 2 Box Office Collections: Karthi starrer spy action drama drops by 50 per cent on Day 2, grosses Rs 7.50 crore in 2 days
entertainment.summary: Karthi and SJ Suryah's film Sardaar 2 grossed Rs 7.50 crore over its first two days, with Day 2 collections at Rs 2.50 crore, reflecting a 50 percent decline from its opening day. The film's performance has raised concerns, as it needs to improve in the following days to achieve better box office results.

entertainment.title: 1980s AI photo trend: Jasprit Bumrah, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Shreyas Iyer get hilarious makeovers - WATCH
entertainment.summary: Social media has embraced a new trend that uses AI to transform contemporary photographs into vintage 1980s-style portraits. Indian cricket players Jasprit Bumrah, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, and Shreyas Iyer have participated in this amusing phenomenon, sharing their AI-generated makeovers online. The trend highlights a playful nostalgia, allowing fans to engage with a humorous reinterpretation of modern images in a retro style.
